Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: Imaging demonstrates either dynamic segmental instability on flexion‑extension plain radiographs (or supine vs upright) with >3 mm translation, OR Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis at the operative level
Patient reports daily significant pain causing functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing)

Failure to achieve clinically meaningful improvement after at least three consecutive months of conservative therapy including prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids and a provider‑directed exercise program, unless contraindicated
No unmanaged major mental or behavioral health disorder (e.g., uncontrolled depression, opioid use disorder, secondary gain)
Verified nicotine‑free status: either never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with objective cotinine test (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal range

Non-Indications: Absence of imaging evidence of instability (no >3 mm translation and Meyerding Grade I or lower)
Pain that is mild/moderate without documented functional limitation
Less than three months of documented, appropriate conservative management
Active tobacco use without documented cessation or objective cotinine confirmation
Presence of spondylolysis (requires separate criteria) or other spinal pathology not listed
Important criteria & exceptions: Nicotine‑free verification may be satisfied by a documented never‑smoker status; otherwise objective cotinine testing is mandatory
Conservative therapy trial may be shortened only if contraindicated (e.g., allergy to NSAIDs) and documented justification provided
Imaging can be flexion‑extension radiographs or comparison of supine vs upright films; either method meeting >3 mm translation satisfies the instability requirement
Documentation required: Flexion‑extension lumbar spine plain radiographs (or supine and upright views) with measurement of translational motion
Static lumbar spine X‑rays documenting Meyerding grade of spondylolisthesis
Clinical note detailing pain severity, functional impairment, and daily activity limitations
Physical therapy or chiropractic records showing ≥3 months of prescribed exercise program
Pharmacy records or provider notes confirming use of prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids for ≥3 months
Behavioral health evaluation confirming absence of unmanaged psychiatric or substance use disorder
Smoking history documentation and objective cotinine test result (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal limits
